benchmark_type: D2Q9 plane acoustic wave - linear dispersion & attenuation
physics: Linear acoustics: plane wave propagation in periodic domain, BGK collision
reference: Discrete eigenvalue of linearized collide-then-stream operator
notes: All 3 grid sizes produce bitwise-identical results between CPU (fp64) and SDAA (fp64). Wave speed convergence: N=16 +0.219%, N=32 +0.054%, N=64 +0.013% (monotone, matches CPU reference exactly). SDAA is ~5-7x slower than single-thread CPU for this small 2D benchmark (expected: SDAA optimized for large 3D workloads).
